{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

Characterise the gene biotype composition of the count matrix using
`org.Mm.eg.db` (offline, via Ensembl IDs stored in the RNA assay metadata).
A BioMart section is included for reference but is not run by default as it
requires internet access.

```{r setup}
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(DT)
library(targets)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r load}
targets::tar_load(mpn_raw_all)
targets::tar_load(proc_params)

genes       <- rownames(mpn_raw_all)
ensembl_ids <- mpn_raw_all[["RNA"]][[]][genes, "ensembl_id"]
cat("Genes in count matrix:", length(genes), "\n")
```

---

## 1. org.Mm.eg.db annotation

Annotation via Ensembl IDs stored in the RNA assay — more reliable than
symbol mapping since it avoids alias ambiguity.

```{r orgdb-fetch}
gene_biotypes <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys      = ensembl_ids,
  keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
  column    = "GENETYPE",
  multiVals = "first"
)

orgdb_df <- data.frame(
  mgi_symbol  = genes,
  ensembl_id  = ensembl_ids,
  gene_biotype = ifelse(is.na(gene_biotypes), "not_found", unname(gene_biotypes)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Matched in org.Mm.eg.db:", sum(orgdb_df$gene_biotype != "not_found"), "\n")
cat("Not found:              ", sum(orgdb_df$gene_biotype == "not_found"), "\n")
```

```{r orgdb-counts}
orgdb_counts <- orgdb_df |>
  dplyr::count(gene_biotype, name = "n_genes") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_genes))

DT::datatable(orgdb_counts, caption = "org.Mm.eg.db — gene counts per biotype",
              rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

```{r orgdb-bar, fig.height=7}
ggplot(orgdb_counts, aes(x = reorder(gene_biotype, n_genes), y = n_genes)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_genes), hjust = -0.2, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Gene biotypes in count matrix (org.Mm.eg.db)",
       x = NULL, y = "# genes") +
  theme_bw()
```

---

## 2. Informative genes (keep_biotypes filter)

```{r informative-genes}
keep_biotypes <- unlist(proc_params$keep_biotypes)

informative_df <- orgdb_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(informative = gene_biotype %in% keep_biotypes)

cat("keep_biotypes:", paste(keep_biotypes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Informative genes:", sum(informative_df$informative), "/", nrow(informative_df), "\n")

informative_df |>
  dplyr::count(gene_biotype, informative) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n)) |>
  DT::datatable(caption = "Biotype counts — informative flag",
                rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

```{r informative-bar, fig.height=7}
orgdb_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(informative = gene_biotype %in% keep_biotypes) |>
  dplyr::count(gene_biotype, informative) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(gene_biotype, n), y = n, fill = informative)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2166ac", "FALSE" = "#d6604d"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "kept", "FALSE" = "excluded")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Biotype composition — kept vs excluded by keep_biotypes filter",
       x = NULL, y = "# genes", fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw()
```

---

## 3. Expression-weighted view

UMI contribution per biotype — which biotypes dominate the count matrix.

```{r umi-by-biotype}
counts_mat <- Seurat::GetAssayData(mpn_raw_all, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

umi_biotype <- data.frame(
  mgi_symbol = rownames(counts_mat),
  total_umi  = Matrix::rowSums(counts_mat)
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(orgdb_df |> dplyr::select(mgi_symbol, gene_biotype),
                   by = "mgi_symbol") |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene_biotype) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_umi = sum(total_umi), n_genes = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct_umi = round(100 * total_umi / sum(total_umi), 2)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(total_umi))

DT::datatable(umi_biotype, caption = "UMI contribution per biotype",
              rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

```{r umi-bar, fig.height=7}
ggplot(umi_biotype |> dplyr::filter(pct_umi > 0.1),
       aes(x = reorder(gene_biotype, pct_umi), y = pct_umi)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_umi, "%")), hjust = -0.2, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "UMI % per biotype (biotypes > 0.1% shown)",
       x = NULL, y = "% of total UMIs") +
  theme_bw()
```

## 4. Genes not found in org.Mm.eg.db

```{r not-found}
not_found <- orgdb_df |> dplyr::filter(gene_biotype == "not_found")
cat("Genes not annotated:", nrow(not_found), "\n")

DT::datatable(not_found, caption = "Genes not found in org.Mm.eg.db",
              rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
              options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```

---

## 5. BioMart annotation (reference — not run by default)

BioMart requires internet access. Run interactively when needed;
`freeze: auto` will cache the result.

```{r biomart-fetch}
#| eval: false
bm_df <- fetch_gene_biotypes(mpn_raw_all)
```

```{r biomart-summary}
#| eval: false
bm_counts <- bm_df |>
  dplyr::count(gene_biotype, name = "n_genes") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_genes))

DT::datatable(bm_counts, caption = "BioMart — gene counts per biotype",
              rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
```
